create_dynamic_loss_scaler: create a DynamicLossScaler instance with custom init_scale, scale_factor, and scale_window parameters
scale_outputs_with_loss_scaler: scale model outputs by multiplying them with the current loss_scale value
update_loss_scale: update the loss scale periodically based on the scale_window and scale_factor settings
check_gradient_overflow: check the gradient norm for inf or nan values and adjust loss scale on overflow
decrease_loss_scale_on_overflow: decrease the loss scale and scale_window when gradient overflow exceeds the tolerance threshold
